headline: Chelsea 54.9%: clear favourites by three-quarters of a goal
summary: Chelsea's win chance rose from 52.5% to 54.9% in recent days, and they are clear favourites against Tottenham at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. The market rates Chelsea about three-quarters of a goal better, a handicap of -0.75. Tottenham are 22.5% and the draw 22.7%, both well behind the home side. Over 3.0 goals is 51.2% and both teams to score is 60.6%, so an open London derby is expected.
